post.summary:
RedeemPairingCode exchanges a pairing code for a device token. Each code
works once; an unknown, used, or expired code is rejected
(UNAUTHENTICATED) without saying which.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: RedeemPairingCodeRequest is sent by the device being paired.

code.description: The single-use code. Treat it as a secret until it expires.

serverUrl.description:
Base URL of the HTTP gateway that devices should use
(server.device_pairing.public_url, or a detected local-network address).

pairingLink.description:
Link that carries server_url and code, for QR codes:
"<link_scheme>://pair?server=<server_url>&code=<code>", plus
"&pin=<cert_pin>" when cert_pin is set.

certPin.description:
SHA-256 of the gateway's TLS certificate (DER), unpadded base64url, when
the gateway serves its own pinned certificate
(server.device_pairing.pinned_tls). A device trusts exactly this
certificate for server_url. Empty otherwise.

v1CreatePairingCodeResponse.description: CreatePairingCodeResponse carries the code and a ready-to-share link.

lastSeenAt.description: Last time the device authenticated a request (updated at most once a minute).

revokedAt.description: Set when the device was revoked.

v1ListDevicesResponse.description: ListDevicesResponse contains paired devices, oldest first.

code.description: The code from the pairing link.

deviceName.description: Name shown in ListDevices, e.g. "Josh's iPhone". Optional, max 100 chars.

v1RedeemPairingCodeRequest.description: RedeemPairingCodeRequest is sent by the device being paired.

deviceToken.description:
Bearer token for all later requests. Returned only here; the server
stores a hash.

v1RevokeDeviceResponse.description: RevokeDeviceResponse is returned after a successful revoke.
